# PanePilot v0.9.0

PanePilot 0.9.0 adds fast keyboard navigation across recent work, project tools, and
terminal sessions.

## Highlights

- Press Command/Control-Up or Down to open client-local recent-work history, keep the
  modifier held to choose another project, terminal, or capability, then release it
  to open the selection in the focused pane.
- Move between Recent work, Project tools, and Project terminals with Left or Right.
  Clear icons, exact terminal attention states, removable recent entries, animated
  transitions, and reduced-motion support keep navigation predictable without
  changing manual tab or sidebar order.
- Remote terminal launches now perform tmux discovery and name-collision checks
  asynchronously, and recovered SSH terminal transports resume accepting input.

## Download

The attached DMG and ZIP support Apple silicon Macs running macOS 12 or newer.
`SHA256SUMS.txt` contains SHA-256 checksums for both downloads. PanePilot has no
automatic update channel; install new versions from this repository.

PanePilot Remote for Android remains available as source under `android/`; this
release does not include a signed Android APK.

Stable latest-release link: [github.com/Salazar-Prime/PanePilot/releases/latest](https://github.com/Salazar-Prime/PanePilot/releases/latest)

## First launch

This desktop build is ad-hoc signed and is not Apple-notarized. After copying
PanePilot to Applications, Control-click it in Finder, choose **Open**, and confirm
the launch. Do not disable Gatekeeper. Download PanePilot artifacts only from this
GitHub repository.
